title: Syndicate Shim Routing Configuration
description: Defines how tasks are routed to specific model backends for each Syndicate agent identity.

$schema.description: Reference to this schema file for editor validation support.

_comment.description: Free-form human-readable note describing the shim's intent and usage.

cli_tool.description: Top-level CLI command used to invoke this shim's backends (e.g., 'pi').

cli_profile.description: CLI-specific invocation profile (flags, tool lists, provider catalog). Intentionally permissive — structure varies per CLI tool.

invocation_template.description: Named example invocation command strings keyed by scenario.

syndicate_version.description: Version of the Syndicate core this shim was authored against (manifest.json active_version at authoring time).

routing_mode.description: strict: use only the assigned backend. fallback: attempt primary, fall back to secondary on failure. cost-optimized: route based on task complexity scoring.

agents.description: Per-agent routing configuration keyed by Syndicate handle.

task_routing_rules.description: Optional rules that override default agent assignment based on task metadata.

fallback_chain.description: Ordered list of backends to attempt if primary fails. Only used when routing_mode is 'fallback'.

identity_file.description: Relative path to the agent's identity Markdown file.

primary_backend.description: The primary model backend for this agent.

secondary_backend.description: Fallback backend if primary is unavailable. Optional.

identity_injection.description: How the agent's identity and Oracle context are injected into the CLI invocation.

task_types.description: Task type tags this agent handles.

context_window_preference.description: Indicates how much context this agent typically requires.

model.description: Model identifier string as accepted by the provider API.

cli_tool.description: CLI command used to invoke this backend (e.g., 'claude', 'gemini', 'opencode', 'ollama').

cli_flags.description: Default flags passed to the CLI tool on invocation.

env_var_api_key.description: Name of the environment variable holding the API key, or null when no key is required. Never the key itself.

endpoint_override.description: Optional base URL override for self-hosted or proxied endpoints.

routingRule.description: A conditional rule that overrides agent assignment based on task properties.

priority.description: Higher priority rules are evaluated first.
